title: Past Continuous
intro:
Past continuous: was/were + kata kerja -ing. Untuk kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung di masa lalu. I dan he/she/it memakai was, you/we/they memakai were.
I was reading.
They were playing football.

exercises.question: She ___ when I called.
exercises.explanation: 'She' memakai was, lalu kata kerja -ing: was sleeping.

exercises.question: They ___ football at 5 o'clock.
exercises.explanation: 'They' memakai were, bukan was. Setelahnya kata kerja -ing: were playing.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the past continuous
exercises.explanation: 'I' memakai was + kata kerja -ing: was studying.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the past continuous
Match each subject to was or were
exercises.explanation: I, he, she, dan it memakai was. You, we, dan they memakai were.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order
exercises.explanation: Subjek + was + kata kerja -ing + keterangan waktu.

exercises.question: Pick the correct past continuous sentence.
exercises.explanation: 'My parents' jamak, jadi memakai were, dan kata kerjanya harus -ing: cooking.
Present continuous jadi past continuous: is berubah menjadi was.

exercises.task: Write one sentence about what you were doing last night.
exercises.modelAnswer: I was watching television last night.
exercises.explanation: Gunakan was/were + kata kerja -ing, misalnya 'I was watching television last night.'
